inviteBody: Somi can show you the main screens. You can skip it and open it later from Account. This tour does not change your data.
continueBody: You left the guide unfinished. You can continue from where you stopped, or skip it and open it later from Account. This does not change your data.
restartHint: Opens the nine-step guide. It does not edit your profile or substances.
engineNote: Temporary tour controls. Visual design comes in a later step.

home.title: This is your home
home.body: Inicio is the hub of your personal expedition. Figures here are educational, not clinical measurements.

nav.title: Move around Soma
nav.body: Use the side menu on a large screen, or the bar at the bottom on a phone. More hides Explore, the atlas, achievements, and Account.

recovery.title: Recovery is educational
recovery.body: These curves illustrate typical patterns. They are not a personal health score and they do not measure organs.

explore.title: Explore the catalogue
explore.body: Here you can browse systems, substances, and processes Soma already teaches. Nothing here starts a medical plan.

anatomy.title: The atlas is a map
anatomy.body: The anatomical explorer is an illustrated map. It does not scan your body.

missions.title: Missions teach
missions.body: Missions are short educational challenges. This tour will not answer them for you.

journal.title: The journal is optional
journal.body: The logbook is voluntary. You do not have to write every day, and this tour will not save an entry.

achievements.title: Achievements mark learning
achievements.body: Medals follow time and learning in Soma. They are not a recovery percentage.

account.title: You can replay this later
account.body: Account holds your details. Substance tracking stays in the separate onboarding flow. Replay this tour whenever you want.
